item.title: Lawmaker files resolution to investigate IEDC
item.description: Rep. Ed DeLaney, D-Indianapolis, has filed a resolution to set up an investigative committee to determine whether corruption or criminal wrongdoing occurred in the Indiana Economic Development Corporation's business dealings.

item.title: Ransburg YMCA announces upcoming closure
item.description: The Ransburg YMCA in Indianapolis is facing closure due to financial challenges, and is seeking a long-term partner and $1 million to stay open for the rest of the year.

item.title: Lawmakers advance transgender bathroom ban
item.description: The Indiana Senate panel has passed a bill that would require all public schools and universities to require students to use bathrooms and locker rooms that match their sex assigned at birth.

item.title: Indianapolis man arrested in connection with human remains found in burning vehicle
item.description: Tallis McCoy was arrested on charges of aiding in murder, arson, and obstruction of justice after human remains were found in a burning vehicle in rural Delaware County.

item.title: Shelbyville Common Council delays annexation for data center project
item.description: The Shelbyville Common Council has delayed the annexation of land tied to a data center project. Thousands of residents have expressed environmental and health concerns.

item.title: Indianapolis firefighters rescue pets from house fire
item.description: Indianapolis firefighters saved four dogs and a cat from a house fire on Thursday morning, and the family inside the home escaped unhurt.

item.title: FBI investigating death of former Colts owner Jim Irsay
item.description: The FBI is investigating the death of former Indianapolis Colts owner Jim Irsay, including the addiction doctor who treated him prior to his death in May.
